goldens.comment: Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-header .panel, which may cause the login panel in the non-Ember/noscript header (where .panel is nested inside .row and not a flex item) to stack under the title instead of remaining right-aligned.
goldens.reasoning: G1 opens by saying that mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. C1 makes the same point: in a flex container, floats (including float: left on .topic-avatar) stop working. G1's second part is about the .d-header .panel location, which C1 does not cover, but they share the same core concern.

goldens.comment: -ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.
goldens.reasoning: No candidate mentions the invalid -ms-align-items prefix.

goldens.comment: -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group require values starting from 1, not 0. If $val is 0, this will cause incorrect rendering in older browsers, leading to layout issues.
goldens.reasoning: No candidate mentions the ordinal-group values that start at 1.

candidates: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:264 - Making `.small-action` a flex container stops `float: right` on its button from working.. Once `.small-action` is `display: flex`, `float` has no effect on its children. The `button { float: right; }` rule (and `float: left` on `.topic-avatar`) is ignored. The button now sits in DOM order right after `.small-action-desc` instead of at the right edge, or on the left if it comes first in the template. `.small-action-desc` also has no `flex-grow`, so nothing pushes the button to the right. Fix: add `margin-left: auto` to the button (or `flex: 1` to `.small-action-desc`), and set `order` if the button comes first in the markup.
